text: Output is structured as a naming review with tiers such as Must Rename and Consider Renaming
Each finding is given as a current-to-proposed pair with a reason
Flags the four different verbs for one read operation (Get, Fetch, Load, Retrieve) and picks a single verb for the whole package
Flags the three different verbs for one create operation (Create, New, Make) and picks one
Flags Update versus Save as inconsistent, and notes that their signatures also differ (id plus input versus a whole struct)
Recognizes that CancelSubscription may be a genuinely different domain operation from delete or remove, rather than blindly renaming it for symmetry
Names consistency or distinguishability as the principle at stake, framing it as a set-level rather than a single-name problem
Proposes the corrected name for every function in the set, not a partial sample
